infoLinks.urlText: John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is not available
infoLinks.content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
For your safety, do not use even if the doors open. Use the stairs or use the opposite accessible entry/exit pathway via Jack Shanahan Park.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 131 500.

Taverners Hill Light Rail Lift 2 between Parramatta Rd (south side) an the footbridge is not available

L1 Taverners Hill lift #2 out of service
infoLinks.content:
At Taverners Hill Light Rail Lift 2 between Parramatta Rd (south side) an the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to or use the lift opposite on Parramatta Road.
For your safety, do not use if the doors open
 
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform or call 131 500
